$comment: Seed metro-worksheet.json for a NEW-STATE fork, emitted by scripts/build_state_template.py as the template repo's metro-worksheet.json. Every value here must validate against schema/metro-worksheet.schema.json AS-IS (the template build regenerates all GENERATED regions from it), so state-specific facts are carried as SENTINELS — 'newstate'/'Newstate', https://newstate.example/, the Null-Island bbox, the StateExplorer namespace — never as {{TOKENS}}, which the schema's patterns would reject. scripts/bootstrap_state.py rewrites every sentinel with the real state's values (scripts/check_template_placeholders.py fails the new fork's CI until it has). metro_explorers is synced from CHI's metros.json at template-build time, plus the fork's own sentinel entry.

layers.label: U.S. House
layers.rank_note: Congressional districts — the largest districts a state carries below the state itself

source.answers: The U.S. House district covering the point, and the representative holding it.

boundary.label: U.S. Census TIGERweb — Legislative, layer 0 (congressional districts), pre-built for the state and shipped with the app

source.people: congress-roster.json, rebuilt weekly by CI from the public-domain unitedstates/congress-legislators dataset — including each member's district office and Washington office.

layers.label: School District (Unified)
layers.rank_note: Unified (K-12) school districts; pre-built from TIGERweb at bootstrap

source.answers: The unified (K-12) school district serving the point.

boundary.label: U.S. Census TIGERweb — School, layer 0, pre-built for the state and shipped with the app

source.people: No roster is joined; the card names the district.

layers.label: County
layers.rank_note: Counties, pre-built from TIGERweb at bootstrap; the fork's offline anchor layer

boundary.label: U.S. Census TIGERweb — State_County, layer 1, pre-built for the state and shipped with the app

source.people: No roster is joined yet; growing this card is the fork's first expansion (docs/EXPANSION_GUIDE.md Part 2).

source.answers: The township or county subdivision containing the point.

boundary.label: U.S. Census TIGERweb — Places / county subdivisions, layer 1

source.people: No roster is joined; the card names the subdivision.

layers.label: Municipality
layers.rank_note: Incorporated places (TIGERweb Places, live); unincorporated points say so

source.answers: The city, village or town containing the point — or that it sits in unincorporated county.
source.people: No roster is joined yet; municipal officials are a per-county build (docs/EXPANSION_GUIDE.md Part 2.4).

anchor_point.note: SENTINEL — bootstrap_state.py replaces this with an interior point of the state's most-populous county

negative_point.note: SENTINEL — bootstrap_state.py replaces this with a point just outside the state envelope

geometry.note: State outline dissolved from TIGERweb by bootstrap_state.py; drives the out-of-scope wash.
Every county in the state, pre-built from TIGERweb by bootstrap_state.py (bounds tightened to the real count at bootstrap).
The state's U.S. House districts, pre-built from TIGERweb by bootstrap_state.py (bounds tightened at bootstrap).
The state's unified school districts, pre-built from TIGERweb by bootstrap_state.py (bounds tightened at bootstrap).

rosters.note: U.S. House roster for the state, built from unitedstates/congress-legislators by bootstrap_state.py and refreshed weekly by update-congress-roster.yml (min tightened at bootstrap).
The Data gaps panel's content; seeded minimal by bootstrap_state.py, grown as the fork records real gaps.

data_sources.note: The machine-checked source manifest lives in the freshness gate; the template ships it scaffolded with the five starter layers' endpoints, and the fork grows it with every layer it adds.

geocoder.poi: Nominatim (office-address pin lookup, Newstate-bounded, serial >=1s queue)
